statement: Every generic real quintic threefold has at least 15 real projective lines.

answer.qualification: Lower bound on ordinary real lines for regular fibres; no assertion that 15 is an attained minimum. Source ambient notation is P^(n+1), so its n is 3 here.

origin.inheritance_basis: Specialize the lower bound (2n−3)!! to ambient n=4: 5!!=15.
